features.name: Specialized Firmware (Expertise)
features.description:
You gain Expertise in two of your skill proficiencies of your choice. Sleight of Hand and Stealth are recommended if you have proficiency in them.

At Rogue level 6, you gain Expertise in two more of your skill proficiencies of your choice.

choices.allowed_options: Eligible skill proficiencies in the source feature.
choices.eligibility_rule: Follow the feature's specific eligibility and duplication rules.

reskin_reference.name: Specialized Firmware (Levels 1 & 6)
reskin_reference.description: Your neural interface is flashed with custom skill software, allowing you to process specific physical or digital tasks with automated perfection.

features.name: Mechanics
features.description: Choose two of your skill proficiencies (or one skill proficiency and your tools proficiency, such as Cyberdeck / Security Tools). Your proficiency bonus is doubled for any ability check you make that uses either of the chosen proficiencies. (Choose two more at Level 6).

features.name: Exploit Vulnerability (Sneak Attack)
features.description:
You know how to strike subtly and exploit a foe’s distraction. Once per turn, you can deal an extra 1d6 damage to one creature you hit with an attack roll if you have Advantage on the roll and the attack uses a Finesse or a Ranged weapon. The extra damage’s type is the same as the weapon’s type.

You don’t need Advantage on the attack roll if at least one of your allies is within 5 feet of the target, the ally doesn’t have the Incapacitated condition, and you don’t have Disadvantage on the attack roll.

The extra damage increases as you gain Rogue levels, as shown in the Sneak Attack column of the Rogue Features table.

reskin_reference.name: Exploit Vulnerability (Level 1)
reskin_reference.description: You use HUD target-lock, sensor scans, or tactical positioning to strike weak seams in sub-dermal armor, unshielded cybernetics, or neural ports.

features.name: Mechanics
features.description: Once per turn, you can deal an extra 1d6 damage to one creature you hit with an attack if you have advantage on the attack roll (or if an ally is within 5 feet of the target and you don't have disadvantage). The weapon must be a finesse weapon or a ranged firearm/smart-weapon.

features.name: Progression
features.description: Increases by +1d6 every two Rogue levels (up to +10d6 at Level 19).

features.name: Street-Net Slang & Mesh-Cipher (Thieves’ Cant)
features.description: You picked up various languages in the communities where you plied your roguish talents. You know Thieves’ Cant and one other language of your choice, which you choose from the language tables in “Creating a Character”.

reskin_reference.name: Street-Net Slang & Mesh-Cipher (Level 1)
reskin_reference.description: A blend of encrypted mesh-net signals, fixer hand-signs, darknet slang, and symbols carved into alleyway conduits by runners in Yoru Market or The Underline.

features.name: Mechanics
features.description: You can hide encrypted messages in ordinary digital broadcasts or conversation. Other street runners understand these messages automatically, while unaugmented corporate suits require an Investigation check to decipher them.

features.name: Weapon Mastery
features.description:
Your training with weapons allows you to use the mastery properties of two kinds of weapons of your choice with which you have proficiency, such as Daggers and Shortbows.

Whenever you finish a Long Rest, you can change the kinds of weapons you chose. For example, you could switch to using the mastery properties of Scimitars and Shortswords.

choices.name: Choose weapon masteries
choices.allowed_options: Eligible weapon kinds as described by the feature.
choices.eligibility_rule: Follow proficiency, weapon type, and replacement restrictions in the source feature.

features.name: Cunning Strike
features.description:
You’ve developed cunning ways to use your Sneak Attack. When you deal Sneak Attack damage, you can add one of the following Cunning Strike effects. Each effect has a die cost, which is the number of Sneak Attack damage dice you must forgo to add the effect. You remove the die before rolling, and the effect occurs immediately after the attack’s damage is dealt. For example, if you add the Poison effect, remove 1d6 from the Sneak Attack’s damage before rolling.

If a Cunning Strike effect requires a saving throw, the DC equals 8 plus your Dexterity modifier and Proficiency Bonus.

Poison (Cost: 1d6). You add a toxin to your strike, forcing the target to make a Constitution saving throw. On a failed save, the target has the Poisoned condition for 1 minute. At the end of each of its turns, the Poisoned target repeats the save, ending the effect on itself on a success.

To use this effect, you must have a Poisoner’s Kit on your person.

Trip (Cost: 1d6). If the target is Large or smaller, it must succeed on a Dexterity saving throw or have the Prone condition.

Withdraw (Cost: 1d6). Immediately after the attack, you move up to half your Speed without provoking Opportunity Attacks.

features.name: Reflex Mitigator (Uncanny Dodge)
features.description: When an attacker that you can see hits you with an attack roll, you can take a Reaction to halve the attack’s damage against you (round down).

reskin_reference.description: Sub-dermal momentum dampeners or ocular predictive algorithms roll your body with the impact of incoming kinetic strikes.

features.name: Vector Roll (Evasion)
features.description: You can nimbly dodge out of the way of certain dangers. When you’re subjected to an effect that allows you to make a Dexterity saving throw to take only half damage, you instead take no damage if you succeed on the saving throw and only half damage if you fail. You can’t use this feature if you have the Incapacitated condition.

reskin_reference.name: Vector Roll (Level 7)
reskin_reference.description: Micro-thrusters, sub-dermal agility augments, or instant hazard detection allow you to dive clear of explosive blasts and plasma arcs.

features.name: Mechanics

features.name: Devious Strikes
features.description:
You’ve practiced new ways to use your Sneak Attack deviously. The following effects are now among your Cunning Strike options.

Daze (Cost: 2d6). The target must succeed on a Constitution saving throw, or on its next turn, it can do only one of the following: move or take an action or a Bonus Action.

Knock Out (Cost: 6d6). The target must succeed on a Constitution saving throw, or it has the Unconscious condition for 1 minute or until it takes any damage. The Unconscious target repeats the save at the end of each of its turns, ending the effect on itself on a success.

Obscure (Cost: 3d6). The target must succeed on a Dexterity saving throw, or it has the Blinded condition until the end of its next turn.

features.name: Fail-Safe Override (Stroke of Luck)
features.description:
You have a marvelous knack for succeeding when you need to. If you fail a D20 Test, you can turn the roll into a 20.

Once you use this feature, you can’t use it again until you finish a Short or Long Rest.

reskin_reference.name: Fail-Safe Override (Level 20)

features.name: Mechanics
